from typing import Optional, Tuple
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch_npu

from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding import RotaryEmbedding

class AscendRotaryEmbedding(RotaryEmbedding):
    """Ascend-specific rotary embedding implementation."""

    def __init__(self, head_size, rotary_dim, ...):
        super().__init__(head_size, rotary_dim, ...)
        self.head_size = head_size
        self.rotary_dim = rotary_dim

    def forward(self, positions, query, key, ...):
        """Apply rotary embedding to query and key tensors."""
        q_rot = query[..., :self.rotary_dim]
        k_rot = key[..., :self.rotary_dim]
        # 遗留的调试 print 语句
        print(f"debug: q_rot shape={q_rot.shape}, head_size={self.head_size}")
        # 调用 NPU rotary embedding kernel
        torch_npu._npu_rotary_embedding(q_rot, k_rot,
                                         positions, self.head_size)
